reviews.text:
Bimbo, a 12-year-old senior dog with a few minor ailments due to his age, stayed for a month at this facility, which was excellent in every way. The location, the organization, the attention to the health and well-being of the guests. A heartfelt thank you to Oliver for his great professionalism, sincere love for animals, honesty, and fairness. The facility also features a veterinary practice and a daycare center. An added help and reassurance. Thanks again to Oliver from Bimbo and myself; knowing you have a point of contact for any absence needs, good or bad, makes life a little more peaceful. See you soon.

Bimbo and Luisa.
I would like to add this year's review to this one from 2025. Grandpa Bimbo was treated wonderfully in August 2026, despite the monstrous heat. He was treated with the usual professionalism and understanding that make Oliver and his entire staff a true source of security whenever we have to be separated from our friends, especially when they are elderly and in need of a little extra attention. Thanks as always to all of you, also for the beautiful grooming that completed the stay. See you soon, Oliver and everyone at the center.
Luisa and Bimbo

We left our Labrador for 15 days and had a great time. Oliver is extremely knowledgeable, helpful, and attentive, and he immediately instilled a lot of trust in us.
We left with peace of mind knowing we'd left him in excellent hands, and upon our return, we found him calm, happy, and healthy. The facility is very well-maintained, with plenty of space and great attention to the dogs' well-being and needs.
We're truly happy to have found a reliable place where we can leave him with peace of mind, even in the future.
Highly recommended!

I left my dog ​​Aki at this kennel for two days. When I picked him up, he was in his clean kennel, and they even bathed him for me. The staff were very friendly. If I ever need him again in the future, I'll definitely leave him with them.

I picked up my dog ​​today after 10 days. It was her first time at a boarding facility (she's a two-year-old Amstaff), and we were a little nervous, not knowing the facility or the dog's reactions. Everything went great; the management is attentive and professional, and the boarding facility is spacious, well-organized, and well-maintained. Oliver is very kind and competent, as are his staff. The grooming service, which can be added at the end of the boarding period, is very helpful. Highly recommended; we'll be back soon!

I want to start by saying that Oliver has proven to be an exceptional person, a caring professional, and a true animal lover: my two cats had a wonderful time with him, and for this I sincerely thank him.
Unfortunately, my experience with the management and owner of the facility was radically different and, in my opinion, unacceptable.
Having picked up the cats early, I politely asked—aware that this was a non-contractual request—if it would be appropriate to waive the charge for the last night. A simple "no" would have been completely legitimate and accepted without hesitation.
Instead, I received a verbal reaction that I found to be rude, aggressive, and deeply humiliating. Following my request, the tone abruptly changed, accompanied by intimidating expressions and seriously offensive names directed at me, which I consider completely incompatible with a polite and respectful relationship between customer and manager.
I'm sharing my personal experience, not because of the financial cost of a single night, but because of the principle of mutual respect. For my part, and for the sake of my animals, I won't be returning.

Our go-to cattery is Oliver, always extremely courteous and attentive to our cats' needs.

This is now the sixth time we've brought them here, both for long weekends and for the August holidays (please book at least a couple of months in advance).

Recommended in Rome. A plus is the local veterinary clinic, which can be helpful if our pets have any problems.
This was a visit for guidance only. The place is beautiful and well-maintained. The owner is meticulous and professional. The dog kennels are a decent size. A positive first impression.

We've been leaving our three dogs (a dachshund and two mixed-breeds) here for several years. The staff is very professional, and we highly recommend them. We feel safe and secure when we're out and about. The professionalism is complemented by a lot of love. Thank you, Oliver :**

I left my Czechoslovakian Wolfdog, Alpha, at the boarding and kennel service for a week and couldn't be more satisfied. Alpha's management was excellent and the facility's organization impeccable.

You immediately sense the professionalism and expertise of a truly specialized dog training center, attentive to the well-being and needs of dogs. Upon my return, I found Alpha in perfect health, calm, and well-cared for, which is essential for me.

I'm truly happy with the experience and the peace of mind they gave me. A huge thank you to all the staff for the care, attention, and passion they put into their work every day.

Highly recommended!

I often take my Labrador to this boarding kennel and I really enjoy it.
What strikes me most is how excited my dog ​​gets every time he arrives, and especially when he sees Oliver, the person who often takes care of him. This, for me, is the most important confirmation of how well he is treated here.

You can sense the care and professionalism they give to the animals. They have different types of accommodations and pay close attention to the type of diet each dog receives, adapting to their needs.

Finally, the grooming service is also excellent: my dog ​​always comes back clean, well-groomed, and happy.

I recommend this boarding kennel to anyone looking for a reliable place to leave their dog in peace and quiet.
I've been taking my animals for a long time... since the 90s... too bad that lately... they keep changing vets... once there was a great man... now retired
Highly professional staff who take care of our four-legged friends. I highly recommend them.

I always leave my dog ​​here when I have to go on a trip, and he's always happy to come. Oliver takes care of all the dogs' needs, and they are treated with the utmost care. Pluses include the on-site vet, grooming service, and training school (all on the same property).

Excellent center, attentive to the needs of our furry friends. Highly recommended. If you need anything, just call; the staff are always available. They offer a variety of services for any need. Super super super.

I brought my 1-year-old Australian Shepherd and had a great experience. The groomer was professional, very good, and very fast.
It was my first time, so I was able to assist, and I'm very satisfied. I'll definitely be back.
A center that has existed for many years... very valid

It's now become a second home for my 8-year-old Pitbull!
Oliver is a professional and takes care of all the animals that come through the boarding kennel, always ready to offer advice.
When I return, sometimes even after 10 days, I've always found the dog healthy and stress-free! Excellent center!

I left my little King Cavalier Toby at this facility for 10 days. They were amazing, providing my little one with the kind of care I'd never seen before. I can never thank them enough. Toby didn't want to leave. Thank you so much, truly.
Perfect for those staying in Rome for a couple of days. It's located near the Sheraton Hotel, Parco dei Medici.

We have a two-year-old Czechoslovakian wolfdog, and finding a suitable shelter for this breed wasn't easy. My wife and I visited 5-6 different ones. Some told us directly that they couldn't keep this type of dog, and we rejected others because they were illegal. Then, by chance, we finally stumbled upon the Canine Health Center, and from the first photos, we noticed the difference. It wasn't easy for us to leave our dog for the first time, but thanks to this fantastic facility, with a super-clean, fully-equipped kennel, and thanks to Oliver, the kennel manager, we were able to leave Grey with peace of mind. A big thank you to Oliver for his availability; he's a fantastic, professional person. In conclusion, this canine health center is highly recommended.
Very organized and well-kept center, very knowledgeable and friendly staff, beautiful experience, I will definitely bring my dogs again because I had a really good time

I've been taking my cat home for two weeks for two years now, and it's always been a wonderful experience. Oliver is always available to give me updates on how my cat is doing, and when I pick her up, I've always found her to be in great shape. I highly recommend him.

We've known this veterinary and grooming center for years, and this year we boarded our cat Maya for the first time. She stayed at the center for 15 days in August and was very happy. This was a very positive experience, especially since we were able to call to check on her and even changed the pick-up date without any problems. Thanks to Oliver and all the staff who keep the facilities really clean. We'll definitely be back.
Great guy, Oliver! I entrusted my dog, Charly, to you and was very satisfied. He was very kind and attentive to everything I needed! I recommend him. I will be back.
Reliable and professional staff. I'm happy to take my dachshund Oliver to them. The center is beautiful and clean.

We left our puppy with Oliver at the beautiful, spacious, and well-equipped facility. The dog was treated with the utmost care and attention, and he returned home feeling great. Thanks again to all the staff who cared for him.

This is the second year in a row I've left my dogs at this facility, both times for a week.
Both times I was absolutely satisfied; I picked them up calm and happy (especially the poodle, who is usually restless), and the grooming service was perfect.

The facility is very well-kept and welcoming.

A special mention for Oliver, always available and attentive.

We'll definitely see you next year.
Cleo, our little beagle, stayed for two weeks. She had a wonderful time, coming home calm, happy, clean, and smelling great. She was welcomed and cared for with great care. Thank you, Oliver.

Recommended by friends, I left my dog ​​there for a week, and I must say that their love and professionalism for our animal friends is evident as soon as you enter the center, which is equipped with everything from grooming to boarding, training, a vet, a shop, and more. It has definitely become a point of reference for my dog. A special thanks to Oliver for the love he puts into what he does.

I left my 10-month-old dog Kira at this wonderful boarding house for the first time. She had a wonderful time. Oliver was exceptional! He took care of her completely and even reassured me by sending me videos. Highly recommended!

I've been taking my dog ​​Macchia here for years, and from the moment I arrived, I immediately felt at ease: the welcome was warm and very professional. The staff is professional, reliable, and above all passionate; it's clear they truly love animals. Throughout my stay, I received updates and attention that made me feel at ease, knowing my dog ​​was in good hands.

The spaces are clean, well-maintained, and safe. Macchia always came home happy, relaxed, and pampered, as if he were part of a family.

I recommend this boarding house to anyone looking for a place to leave their four-legged friend, knowing he'll receive care, attention, and lots of love.

Thank you for everything, Oliver!!!!

We took our Labrador, Birra, to the boarding house for a week. The staff was friendly and professional, especially Oliver, who proved to be helpful and extremely knowledgeable. Highly recommended. Michele and Laura

We took our Labrador to the kennel for a week. I'm very satisfied with the service and the kindness of the staff, especially thanks to Oliver, who proved to be very competent and passionate about his work.
Michele
Excellent boarding service thanks to Oliver and excellent education service thanks to Alessandro

This was my first experience at this facility for my two 8-year-old dogs. I visited to make sure my dogs would be happy (my last experience at another kennel was terrible), and I immediately had a great impression! The place is well-kept and clean, the kennels are spacious and all shaded, there's always fresh water available for the dogs, and plenty of greenery to run around in. I picked up my two pups this morning after two weeks and they were absolutely wonderful! I'm so happy to have found this place where I know my dogs are treated with care by competent people. Thanks again to Oliver for taking care of my two dogs; we'll definitely see each other again.
I highly recommend it!!

I left my cat for a week with very few instructions that were completely ignored (such as always keeping the bowl full, etc.). The result: the cat lost a pound. I also received confirmation of the lack of interest in my words when I cancelled the second week of boarding, expressing my dissatisfaction with the service. I received the same indifference in writing that I had actually seen during the boarding.

My father left two dogs for one night, and everything was fine up until that point. At the end of the stay, he was presented with a bill for an extra €80, claiming he had
washed the dogs without his consent (also because dogs suffer from chronic hearing loss, and he would never have consented to washing them). He was also VERBALLY ATTRACTIVE. And I don't understand why you washed the dogs without our CONSENT (DON'T WORRY, WE WON'T COME TO YOU AGAIN). I FORGOT OLIVER, HE'S A FABULOUS PERSON.
Thank you, Oliver, for taking such great care of Tommy. He didn't want to leave today, and I found him in perfect condition. Thanks for everything. Tommy will definitely be back.

We left our Maltese dog from August 3rd to August 10th, 2025, and found the service to be excellent, professional, and above all respectful of our four-legged friends. The center definitely deserves five stars.

👏
Greetings from Stefania Cecconi
We look forward to hearing from more family and friends …
The owners have made this place excellent; Oliver is a serious and knowledgeable professional. All true... well done!

I left my Maltipoo Charlie for three days and am so happy with the service. Many thanks to Oliver for his care, kindness, and advice! Charlie was happy, smelled great after his shampoo, and even gained a little weight. You can tell the animals here are loved and well cared for. We'll definitely be back!
Thank you ☺️

Oliver, the staff was empathetic, helpful, and welcoming. The place was comfortable, and they were always ready to help you if you needed it.
Thank you for everything. Meeting you was a blessing for us, and especially for our little Lilly.
Very beautiful and well-kept center, inside there is also a restaurant with a wide selection of wines
friendly and professional
Wonderful place, our dog Winnie goes there very happily, she often goes to the daycare and has used both the grooming and the boarding several times and has always had a great time.

The Center's calling card is "your dog's happiness." My dog ​​Ares recently didn't want to come home! Their expertise with furry friends, their approach to clients, and the many services offered by the Center are certainly a guarantee for me, especially when I have to leave him for medium to long periods. Thank you from the Ares Family!

I’m so grateful I found this place! I’m an American traveling (and potentially moving) abroad so I brought my dog and cat along with me. I have an Alaskan malamute dog and Turkish angora (very sweet indoor cat) and Oliver took such wonderful care of my furbabies for 4 weeks while we did some exploring around Eastern Europe. He’s very knowledgeable about animals and you can tell how much he loves dogs and enjoys his work. It was such a relief to know they were well cared for and loved during my time away. 5 stars all around. Grazzie, Oliver!

The center is very well kept. My cat feels great when I leave him there.
Highly recommended

I discovered this place by chance, looking for a boarding facility to leave my two kittens during the holidays. I was pleasantly surprised by the cleanliness and beauty of the place, but above all by the kindness and professionalism Oliver shows towards the animals, but also towards their owners.
Highly recommended

Friendliness, professionalism, availability, and passion for their work.
Extremely clean and welcoming.
It was my first experience, and I must say it was excellent in every way.
From the first moment, we immediately trusted Oliver and the organization and cleanliness of the facility.

I took my dog ​​to their boarding house for five days, my very first time, and I have to say I had a great time. He was very calm, and I also took advantage of the dog bathing option. They respected his character and his fears, even during the bathing process. Thank you so much. I highly recommend it, and I will continue to use your services in the future. 😊😊😊
This is the second year we've boarded our four lovebirds. Oliver is a true enthusiast and his center is impeccable <3

It was my first experience ever. I took my kitten to this center and had a wonderful time. The center is very beautiful and well-kept. The staff is smiling and kind, especially Mr. Oliver, whose professionalism and kindness made my vacation much more relaxing. He always sent us videos to show us that the kitten was doing well. When I returned, I found the kitten in excellent condition. I recommend it.

This is the second year in a row that I've entrusted the Centro Cinofilo Sanitario to kennel my dog, and what can I say... they never disappoint! Courtesy, professionalism, cleanliness, respect, positivity! Oliver is a fantastic dog trainer, he instills so much patience and knows exactly how to do his job!! Raffaele at the reception is always super smiling, friendly, kind, and helpful! Today I also had the pleasure of meeting the Center's veterinarians, Beatrice and Eleonora, who accommodated my last-minute request to examine my dog ​​before leaving and were not only excellent, helpful, and professional, but above all always smiling, kind, and patient! The place is also very beautiful and green, very well-kept, and always cared for!! They have become a guarantee for me, and even though I live a bit far from the center, I have decided to always and only trust them, both for kennel and for the veterinary care of my animals. 🐶🐱 Thank you again from the bottom of my heart and congratulations to everyone, see you very soon! 🐾🧡
Dr. Eleonora is very good, kind and professional.
